label: Bible Study
prompt: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small _____.
verse: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
note: Not the wind, the earthquake, or the fire — God met Elijah in a still small voice.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor _____ thee.
verse: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
note: The promise made to Moses gets handed to Joshua intact. God's faithfulness transfers.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Samson went and caught three hundred _____, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
verse: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
note: Three hundred foxes, paired tail to tail with torches — Samson's fiery revenge on the Philistines' grain fields.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are _____ than they that be with them.
verse: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
note: Elisha's servant saw an army; Elisha saw the mountain full of fiery chariots. Same hill, better eyesight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the _____ clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verse: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
note: 'Miry clay' is mud that grips. The pit was horrible, the clay was miry, and the rock was neither.
